subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB429
title: Prohibits a gun dealer from transferring a firearm or unfinished frame or receiver until 72 hours have elapsed from the time the gun dealer requested a criminal background check, and the gun dealer has received the background check approval number from the Department of State Police.
headline: SB 429 did not pass

claims.text: SB 429 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
